text:
Sam T: Quick sync — we need to finalize which runtime/infra metrics flow to the new 'Visibility' dashboards and how RBAC/ sharing should work. Main constraints: must not expose customer-identifiable tokens, need audit trail for all share actions, and customer-facing views only aggregated. Who owns telemetry schema?
Maria P: Product prefers these tiles: p90 latency by model, request rate, kv_cache_hit_rate, and route fallbacks. Also want "config drift" indicator for rollouts. We also need per-customer quota burn rate for support teams.
Kevin L: Runtime team can emit `request_p90_latency`, `kv_cache_hit_rate`, `route_policy_miss`, `quota_used_percent`, `token_cost_per_min`. We can tag metrics with `customer_id` but agree we shouldn't expose raw IDs in public dashboards.
Dani R: Security: +1 for aggregated customer views. For internal views we can allow `customer_id` but only to roles with `customer_admin` or `support_privileged`. All share actions must write an audit log entry with actor, recipients, and snapshot_id. Retention 360 days for audit logs.
Sam T: @Dani R & @Kevin L — can we implement redaction layer that strips `customer_id` unless role in RBAC has attribute `can_see_pii=true`? Prefer config flag at query layer.
Kevin L: We can. Proposal:
```
metric_query {
  allowed_tags: ["model","region","env"]
  pii_tags: ["customer_id","session_id"]
  redact_pii_unless role.can_see_pii
}
```
Sam T: Nice. How about sharing policies: product wants users to be able to share links to dashboards externally for customers. Security says links must be token-protected and expire. Thoughts?
Maria P: For customer-facing: generate signed URL tied to customer_id, expires in 7 days, view-only. For internal snapshots: allow export of CSV and permanent links but record in audit.
Dani R: Enforce: signed URLs must not include raw customer identifiers. Use one-way mapping token -> customer_id in backend.
telemetry-bot: metric-schema-updated: added field `user_role_context` to events (owner: eng-telemetry).
Kevin L: On RBAC roles: propose default roles: `viewer` (safe aggregated), `analyst` (can filter by customer_alias but not id), `support_privileged` (can see raw customer ids), `admin` (full). Mapping to console perms: view, create_snapshot, share_link, export_data.
Sam T: UX: in the share modal show explicit labels: "This link will allow view-only access to aggregated metrics for customer X (expires in 7d)." and for internal: "This snapshot includes PII — audit entry will be created." Add checkbox "I acknowledge" for internal exports.
Maria P: Also add per-dashboard policy toggle: "Allow external sharing" default OFF for templates marked sensitive.
Dani R: Audit details: record actor, target_dashboard_id, snapshot_id, recipients (emails), expiry_ts, ip_address. Store encrypted at rest, searchable by incident ID.
Kevin L: Implementation plan: telemetry team emits role context; runtime tags metrics; eng-platform implements redaction and share endpoints; product builds modal. Can we commit to a spike next week?
Sam T: yes. Can each team assign a lead? eng-telemetry: @Kevin L, runtime: @Dani R? product: @Maria P. I'll own the PRD and acceptance criteria.
Maria P: assigned. I'll draft UI copy + flows by Wed.
Dani R: security will draft audit retention policy and review encryption by Thu.
Kevin L: I'll own schema changes and add the `redact_pii_unless` flag to query engine.
Sam T: Great. Quick follow-ups: 1) Add automated test for redaction (e.g., query with role=viewer returns no customer_id) 2) Add alerts if a signed link is created for >30d expiry. 3) Make share link creation emit `share.created` event to audit stream.
Maria P: noted. :thumbsup: 
telemetry-bot: reminder: API breaking change window next Friday for metric schema — coordinate if you touch `user_role_context`.
Sam T: Thanks. I'll schedule a 30m sync with leads tomorrow. Endorse if you're in.
Kevin L: in
Maria P: in
Dani R: in
